confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate for a small, high-cost Southwest tourist destination. Restaurant anchors are more certain than lodging; registered hostel dorms and private rooms are especially uncertain because hostel supply is limited. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical local price relationship to draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on US Southwest tourist destinations, with higher restaurant and lodging prices than nearby Flagstaff to reflect Sedona's resort and destination demand.
